main.description: A repository, under the name it has now: its record, its default branch, and how many pulls and issues are open. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

errors.description: No such repository, revision, path or record.
errors.name: NotFound

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

description: A repository, with what its pages show above themselves.
